from datetime import datetime, timedelta, tzinfo

class MyTz(tzinfo):
    def __init__(self, offset_minutes, name):
        self._offset = timedelta(minutes=offset_minutes)
        self._name = name
    def utcoffset(self, dt):
        return self._offset
    def tzname(self, dt):
        return self._name
    def dst(self, dt):

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self._name == other._name and self._offset == other._offset

tz60 = MyTz(60, '+01:00')

dt1 = datetime(1997, 7, 16, 19, 20, tzinfo=tz60)

print(f'datetime equal? {dt1 == dt2}')
